questions.q: A country's exchange rate appreciates. What is the most likely effect on its exporters?
options: Their products become more expensive abroad, so export sales may fall
Their imported materials become more expensive
There is no effect on exporters
questions.why: SPICED: Strong Pound, Imports Cheap, Exports Dear.

questions.q: A rise in interest rates by the central bank is an example of:
questions.why: Monetary policy = interest rates; fiscal policy = taxes and government spending.

options: A period of falling GDP lasting six months or more
A fall in the value of the currency
questions.why: A recession is falling GDP for six months or more; a general rise in prices is inflation.

questions.q: Explain one effect of higher interest rates on a business with a large bank loan.
questions.model: Interest payments on the loan rise, increasing the business's costs, so profit falls (and there is less cash available).
